name: 蕾娜特·格斯滕
src: 山铜纪/山铜纪时段_四_黎明的年月.md:1372
who: Renate Gersten, a human line soldier of a wall fortress in the south of the Long Wall, twenty-seven in 668 and looking it: about 170 cm, sturdy and broad-shouldered, thick strong back and arms from a childhood of farm work. A round face with a dusting of freckles that flush red in the sun. Light pink hair cut off with a knife just below the ears, plain and unstyled. Grass-green eyes that look at the far distance before the road. Palms thickened with calluses, a shallow rope scar across the right palm. A steady, practical, unshowy air; wherever she stands, people feel they have arrived.
build: 170 cm, sturdy and broad-shouldered: thick strong shoulders and back, strong arms, a C-cup, a firm waist and full hips, the build of a woman who hauls two buckets of water uphill without resting.
palette: light rose pink and grass green, patched leather brown, sacking beige-grey, dull iron
casual: Her wall-fortress soldier's kit: an old leather cuirass patched twenty times over seven years, the patch on the left shoulder (on the viewer's right when she faces us) cut from a sack and sewn on by herself; a short spear held upright in her right hand and a round shield with its paint long worn off on her left arm; scuffed wall-issue boots laced very tight with knotted laces. A steady, practical look.
private: Off duty in the reed-shed lanes: a coarse undyed linen tunic with rolled sleeves and a plain grey wool jerkin over it, dark trousers, the same wall-issue boots. She carries two full water buckets on a yoke without spilling a drop. A relaxed, easy half-smile.
battle: Facing the palace stair on the night of the uprising: the patched leather cuirass over the tunic with a small embroidered dike mark on the back, the short spear levelled forward in both hands with a faint rune scratched along the shaft, the dull round shield painted with a dike pattern braced on the left arm, boots planted wide. A hard, forward, determined gaze.
formal: The spring banquet in the carriers' clothes: a clean coarse porters' tunic of undyed cloth over trousers, a washed apron tied at the waist, her hair freshly damped flat, the wall-issue boots still on her feet. She stands with her hands loosely clasped before her, an awkward, honest, proud look.
art: A portrait with the camera tilted slightly, the face large, the green eyes looking past the viewer into the distance with a quiet resolve, freckles flushed in the cold. Pale dawn light from one side, silver and pink. Foreground blur: the shaft of a short spear and drifting breath-mist. She wears the patched leather cuirass with the sacking patch on the shoulder.

name: 约翰娜·施莱伯
src: 山铜纪/山铜纪时段_四_黎明的年月.md:1428
who: Johanna Schreiber, a human court historian of the Crown Dais in Goldkite City, thirty-four in 668 and looking it: about 165 cm, thin, a little stooped from leaning over a desk all her life. Lilac hair pinned up in a coil at the back of the head with a pen thrust through it. A narrow face with a pressure mark across the bridge of the nose where her family's ancient lens, kept for seven generations, clips on; deep blue eyes that squint at people and lean close to words. An ink-stained nail on the right middle finger and a writing callus. A dry, patient, observant air; she looks at a page longer than at a person.
build: 165 cm, thin and slightly stooped from years at a desk: narrow shoulders, a B-cup, a slim waist and gently rounded hips.
palette: lilac and ink black, deep slate grey, pale parchment, dull brass
casual: The Crown Dais historian's dress: a long dark grey robe closed at the neck with buttons and fitted sleeves, two black cloth sleeve-guards over the cuffs, at the belt an ink pot, a pen case and a small paper knife, on the chest a small leather case holding the old pince-nez lens, which she clips onto her nose only to read. The pen thrust through her coiled hair. A dry, attentive look.
private: Late in the record room, the robe unbuttoned at the collar and hanging open over a plain grey linen shirt, the sleeve-guards off and the cuffs rolled, her lilac hair half loosened from its coil. She holds a cold cup of tea and an unrolled scroll. A tired, faintly amused look.
battle: Standing at the upper step of the long stair during the night of the dawn coup, recording rather than fighting: the dark grey robe with the sleeve-guards and belt tools, the old lens clipped on her nose, a scroll tucked under one arm. She carries no weapon.
battle_pose: 3) the record-keeper's outfit: alert and still, standing very straight beside a pillar, the old pince-nez clipped on her nose, one hand holding a pen raised as if mid-word and the other a small writing board; she does not fight.
formal: The coronation records day at the new court: a knee-length deep slate-blue wool court coat with an open folded collar, a small gold kite badge of the Crown Dais at the lapel, clean white cuffs over her wrists, the ink pot, paper knife and a pen case on a belt of old-copper links. Faint lines of pale light run along the edges of the scroll she holds against her chest and along the pen. She stands very upright, a composed, formal look.
art: A portrait with the camera tilted slightly, the face large and turned a little, the old pince-nez on her nose and the deep blue eyes narrowed as she looks straight at the viewer as if reading a line. Warm yellow lamp light from one side. Foreground blur: the corner of a paper scroll with lines of fine script and a pen tip. She wears the long dark grey robe with the black sleeve-guards.

name: 延斯·奥兰
src: 山铜纪/山铜纪时段_四_黎明的年月.md:1599
who: Jens Oran, a human soldier of the new dynasty, twenty-three in 670 and looking it: about 181 cm, tall, broad-shouldered, long-legged, standing with his feet a half step apart exactly as his grandfather did. Platinum-gold hair that is always messy and never lies flat. A narrower face than his grandfather's with a pointed chin and amber eyes that look first at the badge pinned on a person's chest. An old shiny burn scar on the web of the left hand, between thumb and forefinger. When he laughs, half of one front tooth is chipped. Dry-mouthed on duty, honest the moment he speaks.
build: 181 cm, tall and broad-shouldered with long legs: a soldier's frame that can carry a man the length of a wall section.
palette: platinum gold and amber, worn leather brown, faded banner grey-blue, dull iron
casual: His new dynasty infantry kit: an old issue leather cuirass whose left shoulder piece (on the viewer's right when he faces us) is polished bright, cut off his grandfather's old armour and sewn on; a short spear and a round shield; across his back a faded old wall-fortress banner rolled up in a tight roll; at his belt a small cloth bag holding one loaf of bread he will not touch before mealtime. A straight, dry, serious look.
private: Off duty on the river bank, eating his bread: a plain undyed linen shirt with the sleeves rolled, a brown wool waistcoat, dark trousers, boots. The rolled banner leans against his knee. A relaxed, boyish grin showing the chipped tooth.
battle: Holding a narrow lane in the Fourteen Houses' fighting: the old leather cuirass with the polished shoulder piece, the short spear levelled in the right hand, the round shield with a painted dike pattern high on the left arm, the rolled old banner across his back, a short spellcasting wand-arquebus with a small crystal cartridge at the belt. Pale runes flicker on the shoulder piece. A steady, hard gaze.
formal: A guard's formal turn at the new court: a white wool guard coat with an open folded collar and a small gold-embroidered kite at the lapel, plain old-copper fittings, a narrow old-copper belt with the old fortress banner folded and tucked in, polished boots, hair wetted and combed flat though it is rising. A single oath-seal on the belt glows a faint warm amber. He stands very straight, hands at his sides, a stiff, honest look.
art: A portrait with the camera tilted slightly, the face large, the amber eyes looking straight at the viewer, the chipped front tooth just visible in a startled half-laugh turned serious again. Warm low amber light from one side. Foreground blur: the folded edge of an old faded banner and a loaf of bread. He wears the old leather cuirass with the bright polished shoulder piece.

name: 伯尔塔·布伦海姆
src: 山铜纪/山铜纪时段_四_黎明的年月.md:1655
who: Berta Brenheim, a human house-head and wall commander of Cold Well Fortress in the middle of the Long Wall, thirty-one in 670 and looking it: about 178 cm, tall, thick across the shoulders and back, standing like a spike driven into the wall. Straight blond hair cut to the ears, which tangles into a mop whenever her helmet comes off. Sea-blue eyes, the colour every Brenheim has. A square face, a firm jaw and thick brows; when she is not smiling she looks as if she is waiting for an order. Sword-hilt calluses on the right palm. A blunt, unsmiling, dependable air.
build: 178 cm, tall and broad-backed: thick strong shoulders and back, a D-cup, a firm waist and solid hips, long strong arms that carry a sword heavier than most people can lift.
palette: blond and sea blue, wall steel grey, plain unpolished iron, wolf-fur grey
casual: Her wall commander's kit: plain steel wall plate with a well emblem worked on the breastplate and not one gilded rim on any plate, a great two-handed sword slung on her back with its crossguard wrapped in old leather, a brass whistle at her belt used to call the fortress in, and over it all a heavy grey wolf-fur cloak that was her father's. A stern, level look.
private: In the commander's room at Cold Well after the watch: a thick undyed wool jumper with a high roll neck, dark trousers, soft leather house boots, the blond hair damp and unruly, the whistle left on the table. She holds a mug of hot barley water in both hands. A tired, quietly warm look.
battle: On the wall in a siege night: the plain well-marked wall plate buckled up to the collar with runes cut along the pauldron rims that glow faintly white, the grey wolf-fur cloak thrown back, a great two-handed sword held point-down in front of her with both hands on the pommel, a pale thread of light along its fuller, the brass whistle at the belt. A wide, braced stance, a hard, determined gaze.
formal: The house-head's turn at the new dynasty's court: a plain dark blue wool coat over her wall plate, buttoned high with steel buttons, the well emblem on the breastplate, no jewels, the grey wolf-fur cloak folded over one arm. She stands very straight with the sword left at the door and her hands at her sides, a flat, composed look.
art: A portrait with the camera tilted slightly, the face large, the sea-blue eyes looking straight at the viewer, the tangled blond hair just out of a helmet. Cold white light from one side. Foreground blur: the brass whistle on its cord and drifting snow. She wears the plain steel plate with the well emblem and the wolf-fur collar.

name: 海伦妮·克莱门斯
src: 山铜纪/山铜纪时段_四_黎明的年月.md:1711
who: Helene Clemens, a human girl of an old noble house of the upper city, twelve years old in 671 and looking exactly twelve, a small child and NOT a teenager: about 141 cm, thin and half a head shorter than other girls her age, sitting and standing very straight, wholly covered by her clothes. Pale gold hair in two tightly braided plaits that she braids herself, since her maid left. A small pointed face and grey-blue eyes that look at a person's hands first, to see whether they wear gloves. White gloves on both hands all year, even when dirty. A stiff, formal, unsmiling air; she speaks as if reading out a letter.
palette: pale gold and grey-blue, deep navy wool, glove white, a little worn wood brown
casual: Her everyday clothes in the dock district: a deep navy wool dress with a high round collar and long sleeves, the cuffs worn thin, falling to below the knee, over dark stockings; white gloves on both hands with a white kite, the bird of prey with spread wings, embroidered at each wrist; on her feet wooden-soled dockside clogs that a soldier gave her, in place of her worn-through soft shoes. She stands very straight with her hands folded, a serious, formal look.
private: Alone in a corner of the dock lodging: a long-sleeved, high-necked undyed wool house dress down to the ankles and a knitted shawl, the white gloves still on, the plaits half undone. She holds a tin cup of warm milk in both hands. A tired, solemn little face.
battle: Standing her ground at the foot of the ladder in the dockside house during the upheaval: the navy wool dress buttoned to the collar, the white gloves on, the clogs planted on the planks. One hand points firmly down the lane and the other holds a small folded letter; she does not fight.
battle_pose: 3) the dockside outfit: alert and stiffly upright, the clogs planted, her chin up, one gloved hand pointing firmly to one side and the other holding a small folded letter; she does not fight.
formal: On the day of the new dynasty's household register: the navy wool dress brushed clean with a small white collar, the white kite gloves, her plaits freshly rebraided, the clogs wiped. She stands very straight with the gloved hands clasped in front of her, a grave little face.
art: A head-and-shoulders portrait, the face turned slightly, the grey-blue eyes looking at the viewer with a stiff, formal seriousness, the tight plaits neat on both sides. Cool pale light from one side. Foreground blur: a white-gloved fingertip and the edge of a folded letter. She wears the deep navy wool dress with the high round collar.

name: 格罗姆
src: 山铜纪/山铜纪时段_四_黎明的年月.md:1876
who: Grom of the Anvil family, a demon-kin of the bull-horned Thunder-Gaol folk and the locksmith who rides at the tail of the exiles wagon train, ninety-three in 690 but looking about thirty-five, since his folk age slowly: about 246 cm, a colossus with shoulders like a city gate, taller than his father by half a head. Deep bronze-coloured skin, warm to the touch. A pair of long bull horns curving out to the sides, longer than Boru's and never broken, with no rings on them. Dark grey-black hair in a braid at one side, a short dark beard in which thin purple sparks jump when he is angry. Pale grey eyes that look at the door behind a person first. A broad black burn scar across both shoulders as wide as a door lintel. A slow, quiet, gentle air.
build: about 246 cm, enormous and heavy: shoulders as wide as a gate, a huge chest and thick arms.
palette: deep bronze and dark iron, scorched black, a flicker of violet, worn leather brown
casual: His locksmith's clothes: a heavy blacksmith's leather apron over a sleeveless coarse tunic, both arms bare and covered in old burn scars; a short-handled locksmith's hammer on his back, a coil of lock-wire and a bag of nails at his belt; on a leather cord at his neck one old iron key, from the granary of 607. His arms hang loose at his sides, a heavy, calm, patient look.
private: Resting by the wagon fire after the camp has bedded down: the apron off, the sleeveless tunic, the old key still on its cord, heavy boots. He holds a small three-legged stool he has just made, one leg a little short, as all his stools are. A quiet, gentle look.
battle: Standing as a living gatepost at the camp: the leather apron with riveted lock-plates belted tight over the sleeveless tunic, leather bracers, heavy boots, thin violet sparks in the beard. He grips the short-handled locksmith's hammer, its head etched with runes, in his right hand and plants his feet wide, a still, heavy, braced look.
formal: On the evening the exiles are counted at the camp gate: a long heavy dark brown wool coat buttoned across the chest with plain iron buttons over the sleeveless tunic, the apron left off, the old iron key on its cord outside the coat. He stands straight as a pillar with the hands clasped before him, a grave, composed look.
art: A portrait from slightly below with the camera tilted, the face large, the head lowered so the long unbroken horns frame it, the pale grey eyes looking straight at the viewer, heavy and patient. Orange firelight from one side, a few violet sparks in the beard. Foreground blur: a hanging iron key on a cord and drifting embers. He wears the blacksmith's leather apron over the sleeveless tunic.

name: 莉西娅·夜绯
src: 山铜纪/山铜纪时段_四_黎明的年月.md:1932
who: Lithia of the Night-Crimson house, a succubus demon-kin of the feast-born bloodline and head of her house at the exiles wagon train, sixty in 690 but looking under thirty, since her folk age slowly: about 172 cm, tall and graceful, the neck and shoulders straight. Long silver-white hair down to the waist, worn in one thin braid. Short pointed ears. Deep crimson eyes, faintly narrowed, as if looking at you through a wine glass. Black gloves, which she put on after the night of the grey rain and has never changed back. A courteous, sharp-tongued, composed air; she takes the table for people who have no table.
build: 172 cm, tall and full-figured: a straight neck and shoulders, a full bust, a very narrow waist and full hips.
palette: silver-white and deep crimson, black cloak and black silk, a little white rose
casual: Her road dress for the caravan: a deep crimson riding habit with a fitted jacket and a long split skirt, a black cloak over it buttoned to the throat, thin black leather gloves with a ring of black silk at each wrist; at her waist a small leather wallet in which she notes who sat where and who spoke first; on the wagon seat beside her an earthenware pot with a white rose branch. One gloved hand rests at her collar, a courteous, attentive smile.
private: Under the wagon canopy at night: a soft ivory blouse with a high neck and long sleeves, a long dark wine-red skirt, soft shoes, the silver braid loose over one shoulder, the black gloves still on. She holds a small cup of wine untouched and watches the white rose in its pot. A quiet, tired, unguarded smile.
battle: On the road to a table that may become a trap: the crimson riding habit, the black cloak buttoned to the throat, black gloves banded with black silk, tall black riding boots, the small leather wallet at her waist. She carries no blade, for within a banquet truce she never draws one.
battle_pose: 3) the road outfit: poised and alert, the weight on one foot, a calm smile that does not reach the eyes, one gloved hand raised a little with the palm open as if to say you may refuse, the other holding the small leather wallet; she carries no weapon.
formal: Taking the head seat at a settlement table: a floor-length deep crimson silk banquet gown closed to the throat with a high black lace collar, long close sleeves, a short black cape lined in dark red, black gloves banded with black silk, the silver braid pinned up with a thin thorn-shaped hairpin. Tiny red sparks drift along the lace edge and living thorn patterns stir along the hem. She stands very upright, gloved hands folded at her waist, a calm, faintly dangerous smile.
art: A portrait with the camera tilted, the face large, the crimson eyes looking at the viewer through half-lowered lids with a tired, courteous half-smile, one black-gloved hand resting at her collar. Cold pale light from one side. Foreground blur: a branch of small white roses in an earthenware pot. She wears the black cloak buttoned to the throat over the deep crimson habit.

name: 赛勒斐恩
src: 山铜纪/山铜纪时段_四_黎明的年月.md:1988
who: Selephen, a demon-kin night-wing and the eye of the exiles wagon train, fifty in 690 but looking twenty-five or twenty-six, since his folk age slowly: about 184 cm, taller than before, thin and light-boned, broad across the back. Short deep teal-black hair blown into a ragged mess by the wind. Sharp blue-green eyes that look straight at people. Thin pointed ears. A pair of deep teal feathered wings folded down his back like a dark cloak, an old arrow scar at the root of the left wing (on the viewer's right when he faces us) that makes the left wing beat half a stroke slower. A terse, exact, stubborn air.
build: 184 cm, tall and thin, light-boned, with a broad back.
palette: deep teal and teal-black, storm slate, worn brown leather, a little dull copper
casual: His wagon-roof clothes: an old brown leather vest with two slits down the back for the wings, over a plain dark slate shirt with the sleeves rolled to the elbow; a flat leather pouch on a strap across the chest; at his waist a small copper bell of the messengers post with its clapper wrapped tight in cloth, silent since the grey rain; dark close-fitting trousers, bare feet. The wings are folded like a cloak. One hand rests on the wrapped bell, a sharp, unsmiling look.
private: Sitting on the wagon roof at dusk: the vest unbuttoned and hanging open, the slate shirt, the wings folded loose, bare feet hanging over the edge. He holds the flat leather pouch in both hands and looks at it. A quiet, tired, almost boyish look.
battle: Scouting ahead of the caravan: the leather vest closed, the slate shirt, the copper bell wrapped tight at his belt, the wings half open behind him, bare feet. He carries no weapon.
battle_pose: 3) the scout outfit: crouched low on a wagon roof with the deep teal wings half open behind him, one hand shading his eyes as he scans the far road and the other gripping the roof edge, bare feet gripping the boards; he carries no weapon.
formal: When the caravan elders gather the night before a march: a sleeveless dark slate wool tabard over a plain grey shirt with the sleeves rolled, open at the back for the wings, a short charcoal cloak with a drawn cord on one shoulder, the copper bell with its wrapped clapper at the belt, bare feet. A thread of pale teal wind light curls through the cloak hem. He stands straight with the wings folded, hands clasped behind him, a grave, composed look.
art: A portrait with the camera tilted, the face large, the blue-green eyes looking straight at the viewer, the ragged teal hair blown across the forehead, the edge of a feathered wing behind one shoulder. Cold pale dusk light from one side. Foreground blur: drifting dark feathers and the rim of a wagon canvas. He wears the old brown leather vest over the slate shirt.

name: 提尔曼·芬德尔
src: 山铜纪/山铜纪时段_四_黎明的年月.md:2044
who: Tilman Fendel, a human knight of the Thorn Crown order and keeper of the keys at White Fir Keep, twenty-seven in 690 and looking it: about 181 cm, tall and lean, narrow in the shoulder, slightly stooped. Short-cropped flax-brown hair. Blue-violet eyes. A long face with thin lips and a small old scar on the chin from a fall on monastery steps. Large hands with knuckles hardened by years of turning keys. A quiet, careful, watchful air; the keys ring first and his footsteps arrive after.
build: 181 cm, long and lean: narrow shoulders, a slight stoop, big hands with hard knuckles.
palette: flax brown and blue-violet, white surcoat, old mail grey, rust red
casual: His keeper's kit: a white surcoat of the Thorn Crown order with a star crown wound with thorns embroidered on the chest, over an old mail shirt; at his belt a ring of eleven iron keys and a sword in a scabbard, given to him on the day he was knighted, whose throat is ringed with red rust because it has not left the sheath in five years. A quiet, careful look.
private: In the keep's lower passage after his rounds: a plain undyed linen shirt with the sleeves rolled and a grey wool waistcoat, dark trousers, soft shoes, the key ring hanging on a nail beside him. He holds a small bowl of soup for a prisoner, tasting it himself first. A tired, gentle look.
battle: Holding the keep gate against the self-styled order: the white surcoat with a thorn-wound star crown over old mail whose rings are etched with tiny thorn runes, the ring of eleven keys glinting with a thin gold light at his belt, the rust-ringed sword still in its scabbard gripped in his right hand like a club. A tight, wary, determined gaze.
formal: Standing for the order's assembly: the white surcoat freshly brushed over mail, the thorn-wound star crown on the chest, the ring of eleven keys polished, the sword sheathed at his hip. He stands very straight with his hands at his sides, a solemn, composed look.
art: A portrait with the camera tilted slightly, the face long, the blue-violet eyes looking at the viewer with a careful, listening seriousness, as if hearing the keys before footsteps. Cold grey light from one side. Foreground blur: a ring of iron keys and a damp stone wall. He wears the white surcoat with the thorn-wound star crown.

name: 瓦尔德拉克
src: 山铜纪/山铜纪时段_四_黎明的年月.md:2213
who: Valdrak of the Emberhorn clan, a fire-horn demon-kin who walks at the head of the exiles wagon train and leads its redemption band, one hundred and forty in 720 and looking about thirty-two, since his folk age slowly: about 208 cm, very tall, broad-backed and heavy-boned, standing like a crag of burnt black rock. Deep grey skin, as if tempered over and over in volcanic ash. Two intact horns, glossy black like newly cast obsidian, each root held in a ring of the clan's black glass. Black hair cropped very short to bare the horns. Red eyes that glance at your feet before your face. Forge burns on both arms and a fresher burn scar across the chest. A terse, hard, unhurried air.
build: 208 cm, very tall and heavy-boned: a broad back and shoulders, thick arms, a heavy, even stride.
palette: volcanic ash grey and burnt black, ember red, glossy obsidian, worn boot brown
casual: His caravan-front kit: a black leather cuirass burned through in several places and only half buckled, bare arms covered in old forge burns, dark trousers, boots mended again and again on the road; on his back a heavy black obsidian-edged blade that he forged with the heat of his own hands, its edge never dulling. A terse, steady look.
private: By the wagon fire at night: a loose dark grey wool shirt with a high collar and long sleeves, buttoned, dark trousers, the old patched boots, the horn rings left on. He holds a short hand-carved wooden toy soldier between two fingers, turning it. A tired, almost shy look.
battle: Leading the redemption band at the mine pit mouth: the half-buckled burned leather cuirass with an iron forge-core plate riveted over the chest glowing dull orange, forged rune seams on the pauldron, the huge obsidian-edged blade gripped in both hands and planted point-down in front of him, a thin line of orange heat along its flat. A wide, braced stance leaning slightly forward, a hard, determined gaze.
formal: The night the exile elders count their dead: a long black wool coat of plain western cut hung open over the burned cuirass, a dark red sash, the obsidian rings on his horn roots polished. He stands with his hands clasped behind him and his head a little bowed, a grave, composed look.
art: A portrait from slightly below with the camera tilted, the face large, the two glossy black horns framing it, the red eyes looking down and then straight at the viewer, hard and weary. Orange firelight from one side, a few embers drifting. Foreground blur: embers and the rim of a black glass blade. He wears the burned black leather cuirass.

name: 赛壬缇娅
src: 山铜纪/山铜纪时段_四_黎明的年月.md:2269
who: Sirentia, a demon-kin of the deep-tide folk, daughter of the tide-lord family of the salt sea's old shore and a singer of the tide, seventy in 720 and looking about twenty or twenty-one, since her folk age slowly: about 166 cm, soft and supple, narrow-waisted and long-legged. Long deep sea-blue hair that is always wet and never dries. A crown of small thin silver fins at the temples in place of ears. Fine iridescent scales over the cheekbones, and around the neck one band of dull copper-coloured scales unlike the rest. Deep blue eyes that look first at what you are holding. She walks on land like someone who has only just learned. A careful, stubborn, quiet air.
build: 166 cm, soft and supple: a medium bust, a very narrow waist and gently rounded hips, long legs.
palette: deep sea blue and dark navy, iridescent silver, dull copper, oilcloth olive
casual: Her caravan dress: a deep blue short robe to the knees, its hem slit at the sides for diving, belted, over dark close-fitting leggings, soft dark sandals; at her belt a small leather pouch of salt from the old shore and beside it a spiral sea shell, the one she fell asleep holding at the long table at five years old; a notebook wrapped in three layers of oilcloth tucked into the front of her robe. Both hands bare. She holds the shell lightly, a careful, serious look.
private: On the salt flats at dawn, tasting the water: a loose sea-grey linen shirt-dress with long sleeves, a knitted shawl, the wet hair over one shoulder. She holds the shell to her ear. A quiet, listening, faintly smiling look.
battle: Singing the tide on the old shore: the deep blue short robe belted, dark leggings, bare feet in the shallows, the oilcloth notebook tucked away. One hand holds the shell high and the other is raised palm-out toward the water; she carries no weapon. The jacket closes down the front with plain round buttons in a single straight row, no looped cords, no knotted toggles or frog fastenings.
battle_pose: 3) the tide-singer outfit: alert and flowing, standing in shallow water with the wet hair lifting, one hand holding the shell up to her lips and the other raised palm-out toward the sea; she does not fight with a weapon.
formal: When the exile elders meet on the old shore: a long deep navy silk robe with a high round collar edged with pearl-grey shell inlay, loose sleeves gathered at the wrists, a thin pearl-grey overskirt, the pouch of salt and the spiral shell at a woven belt, wet hair worn loose. Water patterns slowly flow along the hem and cuffs of the robe. She stands with her hands folded, a calm, patient, slightly sad look.
art: A portrait with the camera tilted, the face large, the deep blue eyes looking first at the viewer's hands and then up, water beading on the iridescent scales of her cheekbones. Cool silver light from one side. Foreground blur: a spiral shell and drops of water. She wears the deep blue short robe with the oilcloth notebook at the front.

name: 博鲁
src: 山铜纪/山铜纪时段_四_黎明的年月.md:2325
who: Boru of the Anvil family, a demon-kin of the bull-horned Thunder-Gaol folk and the smith at the tail of the wagon train, one hundred and fifty-nine in 720 and looking about sixty-five, with white brows and a slight stoop: about 236 cm, shoulders like a door, a huge heavy frame. Deep bronze skin, dark, as warm as hot iron. A pair of bull horns curving to the sides, the tip of the left horn (on the viewer's right when he faces us) chipped off. Short thin white-grey hair. A broad face, a square jaw, white brows, very pale grey eyes that lower before they look at a person. Hands each the size of two ordinary hands, knuckles pitted with burns. A slow, mild, heavy air.
face: FACE, as in the references: a broad, heavy-boned old demon-kin man of about sixty-five, NOT young: deep lines across the brow and down the cheeks, white brows over very pale grey eyes, a wide nose, a calm, slack mouth. Deep bronze skin, shadows a soft cool brown.
build: 236 cm, enormous and heavy: shoulders like a door, a huge chest and thick arms, the back slightly stooped.
palette: deep bronze and dark iron, scorched leather brown, white-grey, blue lightning spots
casual: His smith's clothes: a leather apron burned through in several places over a sleeveless coarse undyed tunic, both arms bare and scarred, dark trousers and heavy boots; three loops of iron chain wound round his waist with every clasp turned outward; a big smith's hammer on his back, its head spotted with blue marks from a lightning strike. His arms hang loose at his sides, a mild, patient look.
private: Sitting before the anvil with the fire banked: the apron off, the sleeveless tunic, the iron chain loops still at his waist, heavy boots. He holds a child's small iron toy, a rough little horse, in his huge fingers. A quiet, gentle look.
battle: Standing at the forge doorway of the old forge camp: the burned leather apron belted tight, the three loops of chain at his waist, heavy boots. He holds the big hammer in both hands planted head-down in front of him, a thin blue line of light along its head. A wide, immovable stance, a grim, level gaze.
formal: At the camp's evening reckoning: a long heavy dark brown wool coat buttoned across the chest with plain iron buttons, the chain loops left on at his waist, the apron left off. He stands very straight with his hands clasped before him, a grave, composed look.
art: A portrait from slightly below with the camera tilted, the face large, the white brows and pale grey eyes lowered then lifting to look straight at the viewer, patient and heavy. Orange forge-glow from one side, blue lightning light on the opposite edge. Foreground blur: sparks and a link of iron chain. He wears the burned leather apron over the sleeveless tunic.

name: 乌戈
src: 山铜纪/山铜纪时段_四_黎明的年月.md:2381
who: Ugo, a demon-kin of the bull-horned Thunder-Gaol folk, eldest son of the Anvil family, who turned a winch at the bottom of the seventh pit for a hundred and twenty-five years and is now slowly becoming himself again; one hundred and sixty-eight in 720 but his body stopped at the day he went down in 595, and he looks about forty-five, a little younger than his brother Boru: about 241 cm, very tall, gaunt and big-framed. Ash-grey skin like pit stone, bronze showing through. Horns sawn off flat at the roots and rubbed smooth and shiny. Close-cropped iron-grey hair. Very pale grey eyes. A small branded mark on the collarbone and an old ring scar round one ankle. A slow, quiet, gentle air.
face: FACE, as in the references: a gaunt demon-kin man's face of about forty-five, long and heavy-boned, NOT old: deep-set very pale grey eyes, hollow cheeks, a broad nose, a slack quiet mouth, no deep wrinkles, brows still dark. Ash-grey skin with a faint bronze undertone, shadows a soft cool brown.
build: 241 cm, very tall, gaunt and big-framed: broad bony shoulders, long arms, a slow, even stride.
palette: ash grey and bronze, patched brown wool, dull chain iron, a little clay red
casual: His clothes: an old dark brown wool coat that Grom gave him, patched many times and short in the sleeves, over a coarse undyed shirt, wide trousers and worn boots; three loops of iron chain wound round his waist, every clasp turned outward, taken from his dead brother. He holds a plain clay bowl of water in both hands, a mild, puzzled look.
private: Sitting alone by the wagon wheel at night: the coat unbuttoned, the coarse shirt, the chain loops at his waist, boots off beside him. He turns his hand over and over in the firelight as if learning it. A quiet, wondering look.
battle: Blocking a doorway against the dark: the patched brown coat buttoned up, the chain loops at his waist, heavy boots. He stands braced with both long arms spread wide across the frame; he carries no weapon.
battle_pose: 3) the doorway outfit: alert and heavy, standing braced in a narrow doorway with both long arms spread wide across the frame to shield those behind him, his head lowered; he carries no weapon.
formal: When the exiles read the names of the dead: the old brown wool coat brushed clean and worn open over a washed undyed shirt, a folded grey cloth over one shoulder, three loops of iron chain fastened at his waist with every clasp turned outward, the chain links faintly warm with a dull orange glow. He stands very straight with his hands clasped before him and his head bowed, a quiet, solemn look.
art: A portrait from slightly below with the camera tilted, the face large, the flat-sawn horn stumps shining, the very pale grey eyes looking at the viewer with slow, puzzled gentleness. Dull orange firelight from one side. Foreground blur: a clay bowl and a loop of iron chain with the clasp turned outward. He wears the patched dark brown coat.
